Name: World Festivals - a new TV channel -
Author: xyariaa
Description:
The world is wide and diverse, and one year is punctuated with many, many festivals celebrating each culture and traditions.

With this little mod, I invite you to come with me and discover a vast array of festivals celebrated across the world. Through a short daily episode of a new TV channel, you will learn about one such festival or a specific tradition - sometimes why it came to exist, sometimes what it represent to the people celebrating it, sometimes a bit of trivia. Watching this show for the first time each day will also allows you to earn a gift: a little trinket, some food, or a souvenir. All gifts are universally liked by all NPCs, due to their celebratory nature.

In this first 1.0.0 version, this show is only available during winter. It will cover IRL festivals happening between November and January.
[b]If you want to suggest a festival for a future version, please do![/b] Even just the name so I can look it up.
[left]  [/left]
[left]    [/left]
[center][size=5]Disclaimers[/size][/center]
[left][size=3]1) Stardew Valley English font does not support all existing accents. Because of this, some festivals, food, or trinkets names have the wrong accentuation. [b]I know, and I cannot do anything about it[/b]. I really would have liked to be as precise as possible, but alas, it is a technical limitation.[/size][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][size=3]2) My goal with this mod is to spread joy, and allow people to learn about the world. I myself learn about most of these festivals while researching for this mod.[/size][/left]
[left][size=3][b]As such, it is possible I have made mistakes.[/b][/size][/left]
[left][size=3]I do not want to offend anyone with this mod. If you see anything which contradict what you know about one festival, please do let me know![/size][/left]
[left][size=3]However, your personal appreciation of cultures which are not yours is not my problem. If you have anything [b]negative [/b]to say about another culture's festival, [b]please keep it to yourself.[/b] This mod wants to celebrate diversity, not spark debate.[/size][/left]
[left]  [/left]
[left]  [/left]
